description:
crate-jmap-contacts-client/README.md example calls `contacts.share_notification_set(Some(vec!["notif-id-1"])).await?`. No such method exists in jmap-contacts-client. `share_notification_*` belongs to jmap-sharing-client.

Looks like text was cross-pasted from jmap-sharing-client's README and not corrected.

Anyone copy-pasting the README example into their codebase will hit a compile error.

Fix: replace the bogus `share_notification_set` call with a real contacts method (e.g. `contacts.address_book_get(...)`).
title: P1: contacts-client README example calls sharing-client method share_notification_set
